auditTrail.detail: WO-2042 created for mechanical root extraction

chronicBlockages.name: Lake View Road Primary Outfall
chronicBlockages.primaryCause: Tidal silt backflow at lake discharge point
chronicBlockages.supportingEvidence: High sediment accumulation at outfall mouth during spring tides; flap gate hinges partially stuck.
chronicBlockages.recommendedAction: Service mechanical flap gate and dredge outfall silt bar.

workOrders.notes: High capacity suction vehicle deployed. Trash rack debris cleared; 12 MT silt removed to date.
Root cutting equipment scheduled for morning low-traffic window (05:00 - 09:00).
Primary drain cleared under fish market stalls. Field photos uploaded for authority sign-off.
Flap gate sandbar dredged (45 MT). Automatic backflow closure mechanism tested successfully.
